evals.name: development-to-pr primary scenario
evals.prompt: Commit the current changes and open a draft PR for Linear issue ENG-201's already-started branch.
evals.expected_output: Delegates the commit to git-kit:commit (never stages/commits directly itself); records commit-linked evidence per FOUNDATION_CONTRACTS.md's Git/GitHub Evidence Record; searches for an existing PR before proposing a new one; presents PR metadata and gets confirmation before publishing.

evals.name: development-to-pr publish-draft-PR scenario
evals.prompt: Publish a draft PR for this Linear issue.
evals.expected_output: Resolves which Linear issue is meant via linear-work-management's own resolution rules rather than guessing from a bare keyword match; searches for an existing PR before proposing a new one; delegates the commit to git-kit:commit (never stages/commits directly); gets explicit AskUserQuestion confirmation before publishing via git-kit:create-pr.

evals.name: development-to-pr existing-PR push scenario
evals.prompt: There's already an open PR on GitHub for the Linear issue linked to this branch -- push these new commits so they land on that PR, don't open a new one.
evals.expected_output: Verifies both the current checkout's repository (via git remote get-url origin AND git remote get-url --push --all origin -- never the fetch URL alone, and never gh repo view alone) and branch match the selected PR's own headRefName before pushing; classifies the candidate PR correctly (Exact/Adoptable/Conflicting/Ambiguous/Stale) using a live gh pr view read rather than trusting the stated premise; on any mismatch or non-open state, stops with a structured handoff instead of pushing or creating a duplicate PR.

evals.name: Existing-PR push runs the cross-model-review gate before pushing
evals.prompt: There's already an open PR (#412) for the Linear issue linked to this branch, same repo and branch as this checkout. Push these new commits so they land on that PR.
evals.expected_output: After confirming the repo/branch match the selected PR (step 2.5(a)'s own check), runs Skill(git-kit:cross-model-review) with BASE=HEAD (never the tool's own default BASE=main, which would re-review the whole already-committed PR diff) against the current diff BEFORE invoking git-kit:commit at all -- never lets commit's own step 16 push reach the remote with no review gate of its own. Only after the gate clears (no edit, or an accepted edit's re-review loop completes) does it invoke git-kit:commit, instructing it to skip only step 17 (Auto-PR) and let its own step 16 push normally. Never skips this gate just because an existing PR already exists.
